'''Virtual Legacy''' is the [[Players Committee]] Virtual card pool from the 2009 reorganization of the numbered Virtual Sets to the [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]]. It is packaged as '''Virtual Blocks''' ([[Virtual Block 1]] through [[Virtual Block 9]]) and Legacy [[Virtual Shields]]. The cards are no longer valid for current Standard / [[Open]] constructed play; they remain the pool for [[Legacy Open]].

Pre-reorg numbered slips are on [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]. Current Virtual numbering after the Reset starts at [[Virtual Set 0]]. Era map: [[History of the Players Committee]].

== From numbered Virtual Sets ==

From 2002 through early 2009 the Players Committee published printable Virtual game-text slips as numbered '''Virtual Sets''' (VS1&ndash;VS17).<ref name="vslips">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual slips], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20131211224951/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/resources/virtual-slips/ Internet Archive] (11 December 2013)</ref><ref name="tfn2002">[https://theforce.net/ccg/story/Players_Committee_Announces_the_First_Virtual_Card_Set_68946.asp Player's Committee Announces the First Virtual Card Set], TheForce.Net, 12 February 2002. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260930145354/https://theforce.net/ccg/story/Players_Committee_Announces_the_First_Virtual_Card_Set_68946.asp Internet Archive]</ref> The first set was announced 12 February 2002 and tournament-legal Saturday, 9 March 2002.<ref name="tfn2002" /><ref name="decivs1">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020610072829/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/playerscommittee/virtualcardset1.html Virtual Card Set #1 is Away!], decipher.com (Wayback)</ref>

Players sleeved the PDF cutouts over Decipher cards. Fifth Anthology was previewed as the 18th Virtual Set in June 2009 but never shipped as a standalone <code>VirtualCards18.pdf</code>; its preview titles shipped inside Reflections IV / [[Virtual Block 6]]. Full VS18 story: [[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]].

== 2009 Block reorganization ==

In August/September 2009 the Players Committee regrouped the numbered Virtual Sets into six thematic '''Virtual Blocks'''.<ref name="reorg2009">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090918131415/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org homepage], Wayback 18 September 2009</ref> VirtualBlock1.pdf, stamped '''Official text as of 7 December 2009''', describes the change (Blocks 2&ndash;5 carry the same text):<ref name="blockreorg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf VirtualBlock1.pdf] (official text as of 7 December 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250925215932/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

: ''“Since the reorganization of the previous 18 virtual sets, there are now six blocks structured by theme. The first three blocks cover the classic trilogy, block 4 expands the expanded universe, the fifth block buffs the Old Republic, and block 6 is a mix - Reflections IV.”''

The Blocks repackaged the pre-Reset pool; they did not simply rename the old Virtual Set PDFs. Titles, frames, errata, and which cards remain legal can differ.

== Virtual Blocks ==

The Players Committee virtual-slips library labels '''Legacy Virtual Sets (2002&ndash;2009)''' separately from '''Legacy Virtual Blocks (2009&ndash;2014)'''.<ref name="vslips" /> The printable Master Lists name the nine Blocks “Virtual Set N”, with the themes below.<ref name="masterds">[[:File:Virtual Legacy Final Master DS.pdf]] (icon key, page 2); [http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf MasterDS.pdf]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive] (4 July 2017)</ref><ref name="masterls">[[:File:Virtual Legacy Final Master LS.pdf]] (icon key, page 2); [http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf MasterLS.pdf]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive] (5 July 2017)</ref>

September 2009 on Blocks 1&ndash;6 is the reorganization date; those cards were first released across 2002&ndash;2009 as Virtual Sets 1&ndash;18.

[[Virtual Shields]] is the Legacy / Block packaging of Defensive Shields (Original-era slips: [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]]), grouped as Virtual Block Defensive Shields in September/October 2009.

== Later blocks (7&ndash;9) ==

Blocks 7&ndash;9 are post-reorg expansions, not part of the original six-block remap.

* '''[[Virtual Block 7]]''' (Darkness Rising / Ultimate series). First subset Virtual Set 7.1 Ultimate Power ~27 June 2010.<ref name="vb71">[https://star-wars.pl/News/12035,Premiera_Virtual_Block_7_1_Ultimate_Power.html Premiera Virtual Block 7.1 Ultimate Power], star-wars.pl. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20150524083017/http://www.star-wars.pl/News/12035,Premiera_Virtual_Block_7_1_Ultimate_Power.html Internet Archive] (24 May 2015)</ref> Later subsets: 7.2 Ultimate Freedom (released 13 December 2010; tournament legal 29 December 2010); 7.3 Ultimate Conflict (3 June 2011); 7.4 Ultimate Legacy (16 December 2011).
* '''[[Virtual Block 8]]''' (Scoundrels). First subset Virtual Set 8.1 Scoundrels, May 2012.<ref name="vb81">[https://web.archive.org/web/20120510015711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org homepage], Wayback 10 May 2012</ref> Later subsets: 8.2 Agents For Hire (20 September 2012); 8.3 A Wretched Hive (March 2013 window).
* '''[[Virtual Block 9]]''' (Republic At War). Virtual Set 9.1 ''Republic at War'' was released 10 January 2014 and legal immediately.<ref name="vb91">[https://web.archive.org/web/20140115143606/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/v-set-9-1-is-live/ V-Set 9.1 is Live], starwarsccg.org (Wayback 15 January 2014)</ref> Virtual Set 9.2 was not released in its then-current form; the Reset announcement cancelled that plan in favor of a mini Worlds set that was remolded later. Details: [[Cancelled Virtual Sets]].

== Printable Master Lists ==

The combined printable master of the pre-Reset virtual pool is two Players Committee PDFs titled '''''Virtual Cards: Master List''''' (Dark Side 59 pages; Light Side 54 pages):

* [[:File:Virtual Legacy Final Master DS.pdf]]
* [[:File:Virtual Legacy Final Master LS.pdf]]

Internet Archive captured the Players Committee Resources copies of the Dark Side and Light Side Master Lists in July 2017:

* [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf MasterDS.pdf] (Wayback 4 July 2017 of [http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf])
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf MasterLS.pdf] (Wayback 5 July 2017 of [http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf])

The cover banner is '''Official text as of 27 April 2013'''. The files are dated '''3 February 2014''' (author Jeremy Gardner, Graphic Design Team; copyright SWCCG Players Committee 2014), after Virtual Set 9.1 and before the Reset announcement.<ref name="masterds" /><ref name="masterls" /> They hold the up-to-date text of every Players Committee virtual card, sorted alphabetically by card type. The slips are printable, to sleeve over original cards. Some slips supersede earlier Virtual Block presentations of the same titles.

An HTML type list of the same combined pool is [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html VMasterType.html].<ref name="vmaster">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html Virtual Master type list], res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20201030095838/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html Internet Archive] (30 October 2020)</ref> The current Players Committee Legacy format page is [https://www.starwarsccg.org/legacy/ starwarsccg.org/legacy/] (updated 30 July 2022).<ref name="pclegacy">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/legacy/ Legacy], starwarsccg.org</ref>

The July 2014 Reset announcement said Legacy would keep all pre-Reset Virtual cards in a Master Legacy PDF (a fixed pool unless later Design &amp; Development work supported Legacy balance).<ref name="reset-announce">[http://web.archive.org/web/20141020142523id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Reset of Standard Format] (Wayback id_ capture), byline 25 July 2014</ref>

== 2014 Reset ==

On 25 July 2014 the Advocate Council published '''''Reset of Standard Format''''' and chose a complete reset of the virtual card pool rather than a cleanup / mass errata.<ref name="reset-announce" /> New Standard used a small base set (later [[Virtual Set 0]]) and new Virtual set numbering. Pre-Reset Virtual cards became the [[Legacy Open|Legacy]] format. Follow-up legal lists (Virtual Set 0 and Virtual Set 1 Preview) were posted 25 September 2014. Main article: [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]].

The [[2014 World Championship]] (21&ndash;24 August 2014, Toronto) was the last championship circuit on the old Block pool.<ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210624200645/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
